metric: App commit timestamp to first Canvas point draw submission (first_draw_submitted trace)
question: Compare vessel speeds by hour over the last 24 hours

dataset.label: North Atlantic · synthetic vessel telemetry
dataset.description: Six fictional vessels, one reading per minute, 1–14 September 2026 UTC. Deterministic synthetic data; speed and wind in knots, wave height in metres, water temperature in °C.

method.inference: CPU-only deterministic templates; no LLM inference
method.database: Warm DuckDB-Wasm in browser; same loaded synthetic table across modes
method.input: Playwright DOM fill and real browser Enter key dispatch
method.speculation_on: Wait for all 144 points staged before Enter; prepared-hit best case
method.speculation_off: Enter without a prepared candidate; query executes after commit
method.order: Paired trials; alternating OFF/ON and ON/OFF order

limitations: Draw submission is not presentation, scanout, or photons reaching the eye.
Headless Chromium launched with --disable-gpu; no hardware-GPU latency claim.
Uncontrolled shared host, no CPU isolation, thermal control, or power-state control.
Repeated exact query on a warm synthetic dataset; startup and model latency are excluded.
Prepared-hit measurements move work before Enter and do not estimate hit rate or total resource cost.
Small sample, development server, browser automation; results are evidence for this run, not a target guarantee.
